labels.text: The 2023 FIFA Women's World Cup is held in Australia and New Zealand. In the final, Spain wins 1–0 against England.
The 2023 Cricket World Cup is held in India, with Australia defeating India in the final.
2023 Australian Indigenous Voice referendum: A majority of Australians vote against establishing an Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Voice in the constitution.
In the Falepili Union treaty, Australia grants "special" freedom of movement and defence rights to Tuvaluans for residence and employment for climate reasons.
WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange leaves the United Kingdom after being freed from prison in a plea deal with the United States. He returns to his native Australia two days later.
Colossal Biosciences and University of Melbourne create the world's first artificial womb in marsupials as part of their project toward de-extinction of the thylacine.
2025 Australian federal election: The incumbent Labor Party led by Anthony Albanese wins reelection, increasing their majority.
The UK, Canada, and Australia announce their formal recognition of Palestine as a sovereign state, with France also doing so the next day.
